test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 941 915 741 807 776 (Right)

(Example-697- First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number?
solution:
The given three-digit numbers are: 941, 915, 741, 807, 776.

Now,

The highest number is 941. Its third digit is 1.

The lowest number is 741. Its first digit is 7.

Perform the addition.

Add the third digit of the highest number 1 to the first digit of the lowest number 7.

1 + 7 = 8.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
